newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia set to launch second industrial plan.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia set to launch second industrial plan.

text.p: Malaysia's Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad will launch the second Industrial Master Plan (IMP) for the 1996-2005 period on November 28, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Tuesday.

The plan will aim at moving forward Malaysia's industrialisation over the next 10 years through high-technology and capital intensive industries, the national Bernama news agency said quoting a MITI statement.

Under the previous plan, which focused on large investments and rapid industrialisation, Malaysia attracted substantial foreign capital and technology to maintain an over eight percent economic growth for the past nine years.

The new plan would encourage forward and backward linkages within an industry. This would be complemented by developing local support industries, similar to the development that has taken place in California's Silicon Valley, MITI said.
